cohort: A large cohort of 16,908 pregnancies, including both twin and singleton pregnancies, was studied.
finding: Twin gestation significantly increases the risk of placenta accreta and adverse perinatal outcomes compared to singleton pregnancies, with placenta accreta mediating some of the observed effects.
mod_finding: The risk of caesarean section was substantially higher in twin pregnancies with placenta accreta, and placenta accreta was found to mediate the effect of twin gestation on caesarean section.
